post.title: Black Friday Hit $9.7 Billion by Dinner. Your Phone Made It Painless. #shorts
post.description: US shoppers spent $9.7 billion online on Black Friday by 6:30 p.m. ET, up about 13% on last year, and Adobe expects $13 to $13.4 billion for the full day. Gus and Nell talk about the pain of paying: in a 2001 MIT study by Drazen Prelec and Duncan Simester, people paying by credit card bid up to twice as much for Celtics tickets as people paying cash. Cards and phone taps numb the sting, so we spend more. Did you check your total this weekend? Comment below. Sources: Reuters (Nov 27, 2026); Investing.com (Nov 27, 2026), both citing Adobe Analytics.
